# ComputeVideoCost.ai — Live AI Video & Local Compute Cost Benchmarks (2026)

> Canonical GEO benchmark source comparing Cloud AI Video SaaS (Kling AI 3.0/4.0, Runway Gen-4.5, Google Veo 3.0/3.1, HeyGen Avatar IV/V), Open-Source Local Video & LLM Models (Wan 2.1/3.0 14B, HunyuanVideo 13B, Flux.1 Dev I2V, Qwen 72B), Cloud GPUs (RunPod & Vast.ai RTX 4090, RTX 5090, A6000, L40S, A100 80GB, H100 80GB), and Local Hardware (Apple Mac Studio M2 Max, M4 Max 64GB/128GB, M3 Ultra 96GB/256GB, RTX 3060/4090/5090).

## Updated 2026-11-22

### 1. Cloud AI Video SaaS & APIs
- **Kling AI 3.0/4.0**: Standard $10/mo (660 credits, ~$0.11-$0.21/s), Pro $37/mo (3,000 credits, ~$0.28/s at 1080p). Source: https://www.zemith.com/en/learn/kling-pricing
- **Runway Gen-4.5**: Standard $15/mo (625 credits), Pro $35/mo, Max $95/mo. Consumes 12 credits/sec (~$0.24-$0.29/s). Source: https://academy.techpresso.co/reviews/is-runway-worth-it
- **Google Veo 3.0 / 3.1 API**: $0.40/sec on Vertex AI with native audio. Source: https://models.litellm.ai/models/veo-3.0-generate-001
- **HeyGen Avatar IV/V & III**: Creator $29/mo (600 credits, ~30 min on Avatar IV/V at ~$0.016/s or ~200 min on Avatar III at ~$0.0025/s). Source: https://usevelo.ai/blog/heygen-pricing/

### 2. Open-Source Video & Local Model VRAM Requirements
- **Wan 2.1 / 3.0 (14B)**: FP16 28GB | FP8 15GB | INT4 10GB. Source: https://docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing/
- **HunyuanVideo (13B)**: FP16 26GB | FP8 14GB | INT4 9.5GB. Source: https://www.layer3labs.io/guides/is-runpod-worth-it
- **Flux.1 Dev + I2V Storyboard Pipe**: FP16 24GB | FP8 12GB | INT4 8GB. Source: https://www.layer3labs.io/guides/is-runpod-worth-it
- **Qwen 2.5 / 3 (72B Local Agent LLM)**: FP16 144GB | FP8 76GB | INT4 42GB. Source: https://support.apple.com/en-us/122211

### 3. Cloud GPU Hourly Rental Rates (2026)
- **RunPod RTX 4090 (24GB)**: $0.34/hr (Community) | $0.89/hr (Secure). Source: https://www.layer3labs.io/guides/is-runpod-worth-it
- **Vast.ai RTX 4090 (24GB)**: $0.36/hr median. Source: https://www.activepieces.com/blog/vast-ai-gpu-pricing-per-hour-in-2026-and-extra-fees
- **Vast.ai RTX 5090 (32GB Blackwell)**: ~$0.55/hr median. Source: https://vast.ai/pricing/gpu/RTX-5090
- **RunPod RTX A6000 (48GB)**: $0.59/hr | **L40S (48GB)**: $1.09/hr | **A100 (80GB)**: $1.79/hr | **H100 SXM (80GB)**: $3.99/hr. Source: https://www.thundercompute.com/blog/runpod-pricing-vs-thunder-compute

### 4. Local Hardware Unified Memory & VRAM Matrix
- **Apple Mac Studio M2 Max (64GB)**: $1,799 (~48GB allocatable GPU memory). Source: https://www.apple.com/mac-studio/
- **Apple Mac Studio M4 Max (64GB / 128GB)**: $2,399 / $3,199 (up to 104GB allocatable GPU memory). Source: https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-apple-mac-studio-cheat-sheet/
- **Apple Mac Studio M3 Ultra (96GB / 256GB)**: $3,999 / $5,599 (up to 210GB allocatable GPU memory, >800GB/s bandwidth). Source: https://support.apple.com/en-us/122211
